verdict.rationale: Unreal Engine is a game/real-time 3D engine product, not a service that collects, stores, or processes user data on a vendor's behalf — 'data retention and deletion' controls (e.g., account/user data lifecycle policies) are a SaaS/data-processor concern, not applicable to a locally-installed engine/SDK. The evidence pack contains no first-party data-handling or privacy-controls documentation, confirming this axis is a category mismatch for this product type.
